in_game.name: Better Jump Pads
in_game.description: More Jump Pads with less random positions.

in_game.name: Paycheck
in_game.description: Gain ﹢40 (﹢10 per beaconed player) Golden Gifts every round if half or more of the players survive.

in_game.name: Business License
in_game.description: ﹢25% Golden Gift yield. (Max 50%)

in_game.name: Swiftness Ring
in_game.description: ﹢10% Movement speed (Max 30%).

in_game.name: Grapple Points
in_game.description: Harder to reach Jump Pads that are smaller, with a more powerful boost.

in_game.name: Medal
in_game.description: On Collapse and on odd levels, the Medal spawns, bring it to the beacon for Golden Gifts and the option to pick a difficult curse for Golden Gifts. Choosing to pick a difficult curse increases future Golden Gifts rewards. Carrying it gives an extra double jump but disables abilities.

in_game.name: Tria Orbs
in_game.description: Makes Orbs appear around the map, Orbs boost you after jumping out of them.

in_game.name: Double Jump
in_game.description: Allows you to double jump.

in_game.name: Radar
in_game.description: Arrow always appears and highlights all nearby gifts.

in_game.name: Radar Module: Enemies
in_game.description: Tracks enemies through walls.

in_game.name: Fanny Pack
in_game.description: During collapse, some tiles turn yellow. Collecting all gifts from these tiles gives bonus Golden Gifts.

in_game.name: Grace Wings
in_game.description: Greatly enhances air control.

in_game.name: Pocket Bell
in_game.description: An extra double jump.

in_game.name: Radar Module: Altars
in_game.description: Marks the location of all unused altars every 12 seconds.

in_game.name: Ice Skates
in_game.description: Less slipping on ice. Going in one direction for a while slowly gives a speed boost.

in_game.name: Helmet
in_game.description: Bonking sends you upwards and allows full control.

in_game.name: Advanced Gravity Coil
in_game.description: 25% Increased maximum jump height. Controllable jump height. Hold space to jump higher, tap space to jump lightly.

in_game.name: More Altars
in_game.description: Spawns an extra Altar.

in_game.name: Larger Grapple Points
in_game.description: Grapple Points are 25% larger.

in_game.name: Ninja Belt
in_game.description: Gives the player an alternate ability according their class.

in_game.name: Radar Module: Instruments
in_game.description: Marks the location of Cadence's instruments every 12 seconds and gives you an arrow pointing towards instruments.

in_game.name: Shark Tail
in_game.description: Gives the player conversion to vertical movement according to their class.

in_game.name: Sport Shoes
in_game.description: ﹢40% Movement speed.

in_game.name: Gift Magnet
in_game.description: Increases pickup range by .5 studs. (Max 1.5 studs)

in_game.name: Matrix Tetrahedron
in_game.description: Instant Acceleration. Completely Removes the slippery/icey movement.

in_game.name: Shield
in_game.description: Allows you to take an extra hit. Doesn't protect you from the Void.

in_game.name: Panic Necklace
in_game.description: When your last shield breaks, gain debuff immunity, movement speed and ﹢2 pickup range for 40 seconds.

in_game.name: Miniature Hourglass
in_game.description: Gives the player a unique passive according to their class.

in_game.name: Gift Idol
in_game.description: Collecting gifts has a ﹢1% chance to collect nearby gifts. (Max 5%)

in_game.name: Drowned Ægis
in_game.description: Altar of Protection also gives a one time Void shield that teleports you out of the Void.

exclusive.name: Orb
exclusive.note: Free; Casual difficulty replacement for Tripmine upgrades

exclusive.name: Adrenaline
exclusive.note: Replaces Last Robloxian Standing in Solo/Duo

exclusive.name: Defuse Kit
exclusive.description: ﹢20% Chance for Tripmines to not explode. (Max 60%)

exclusive.name: Last Robloxian Standing
exclusive.description: Gain a movement speed boost, 4 seconds of invincibility, and a shield when you are the last one alive.

exclusive.name: Subspacial Barrier
exclusive.description: Allows you take an extra hit from Tripmines and Void Implosions.
